name: net.http
doc:
The Zell-source net.http (see sema/stdsrc.rs for the rules), split
over several files of this namespace:
  http.zl          shared helpers, Request/Response, URLs, connections
  http_server.zl   Server (HTTP/1.1 keep-alive loop), Router, middleware chain
  http_client.zl   Client, Transport (connection pool, proxies), cookies
  http2.zl         HTTP/2 (RFC 9113) frames, streams, flow control (net.http.hpack)
  http_extra.zl    middleware, ServeFile/ServeDir, Server-Sent Events
The hot loops (head scanning/parsing, header canonicalisation, response
heads, WebSocket masking, HPACK Huffman) are C in runtime/src/std_http.c
(the rt* externs, runtime/ABI.md 16.5). Bodies are strings (byte strings:
any bytes are allowed); https and Server.TLS use net.tls.

are. level: 1..9 (0: 6).

items.name: Recover
items.doc:
Recover turns a handler error into a logged 500 "Internal Server Error"
without the error text (the server's default 500 includes it).
ErrAbortHandler passes through. Panics are not recoverable in Zell:
they still end the process.

items.name: ServeFile
items.signature: async func ServeFile(req *Request, res *Response, path string) void!
items.doc:
ServeFile answers req with the file at path: Content-Type from the
extension (mime), ETag and Last-Modified with conditional requests
(If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since -> 304; If-Match,
If-Unmodified-Since -> 412), byte ranges (206, multipart/byteranges for
several, 416 when unsatisfiable, If-Range), HEAD, and the body sent with
sendfile(2). A directory serves its index.html. Missing files get 404.
items.summary: ServeFile answers req with the file at path: Content-Type from the extension (mime), ETag and Last-Modified with conditional requests (If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since -> 304; If-Match, If-Unmodified-Since -> 412), byte ranges (206, multipart/byteranges for several, 416 when unsatisfiable, If-Range), HEAD, and the body sent with sendfile(2).

items.name: TimeoutHandler
items.signature: func TimeoutHandler(h Handler, ms int, msg string) Handler
items.doc:
TimeoutHandler runs h with a time limit of ms milliseconds (its waits are
cancelled through the task context when it expires) and answers 503
with msg if it has not finished by then. The handler writes into a
buffered response that is copied out when it finishes in time (Flush is
buffered too).
items.summary: TimeoutHandler runs h with a time limit of ms milliseconds (its waits are cancelled through the task context when it expires) and answers 503 with msg if it has not finished by then.

items.name: Client
items.doc:
Client sends requests. Timeout (milliseconds, 0 = none) applies to the
connect and to every network read and write; TotalTimeout limits a whole
request (task-context deadline). MaxRedirects (default 10 when 0,
negative = do not follow) limits followed redirects. Connections are
pooled by the Transport (the process-wide default one when nil); Jar
stores and sends cookies.
items.summary: Client sends requests.

items.name: EventSource
items.doc:

`await es.Next()`) yields events; when the stream ends it reconnects
after the retry time (default 3000 ms, or the server's `retry:`) with
Last-Event-ID, up to MaxRetries times in a row (default 3, negative =
never reconnect). Close stops it.

members.name: Flush
members.doc:
Server side: sends the status, the headers and the body written so
far, and empties Body; later writes go out with the next Flush or
when the handler returns (HTTP/1.1: chunked transfer encoding;
HTTP/2: DATA frames). A no-op on a recorder (it only counts).

items.name: Router
items.doc:
Router dispatches by method and path pattern; "{name}" segments match
any one segment and are stored in req.Params, a final "*" matches the
rest of the path. Unknown paths get 404, other methods 405 (with Allow);
HEAD requests are served by GET routes. Use(mw) adds middleware (a
`func(next Handler) Handler`) around every route, in the order added.
items.summary: Router dispatches by method and path pattern; "{name}" segments match any one segment and are stored in req.Params, a final "*" matches the rest of the path.

items.name: Server
items.doc:
Server serves HTTP/1.1 (and HTTP/2) on Addr ("host:port"; port 0 picks a
free one; "unix:/path" listens on a Unix socket). Every connection is a
task; keep-alive connections serve their requests in order, HTTP/2
connections run one task per stream. IdleTimeout (ms, default 5000)
closes connections that send nothing; Shutdown stops accepting, closes
idle connections and waits for the requests in flight.
items.summary: Server serves HTTP/1.1 (and HTTP/2) on Addr ("host:port"; port 0 picks a free one; "unix:/path" listens on a Unix socket).

members.name: StreamBodies
members.doc:
Request bodies are not buffered: the handler runs once the head is
read, req.Body is "" and req.Reader streams the body (HTTP/1.1 and
HTTP/2). MaxBodyBytes still applies: the reader fails with
ErrBodyTooLarge (a handler returning that error answers 413).
